Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1641347. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain identifiers and structures. Filter rows where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Require exact matches and keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
